description: This file contains the implementation of the PermissionDao interface, providing database operations related to Permission entities such as listing permissions, retrieving by ID, filtering by groups, and querying by specific criteria.

classes.name: PermissionDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for PermissionDao, managing permissions persistence operations.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Returns a list of all permissions ordered by their ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Permission entity by its ID.

methods.name: getPermissionsListByGroups
methods.description: Fetches permissions associated with specific group IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Retrieves a list of permissions based on specified criteria, including group filters and pagination.
